verdict.rationale: Aleph's own docs list spreadsheet data alongside HRIS, ATS and ERP as a live source behind headcount planning. They also describe bi-directional Excel and Google Sheets pull/push sync, which suggests spreadsheets can feed the data layer. However, no doc describes uploading a CSV or registering a spreadsheet as a standalone, first-class source when no connector exists. Missing for 10: explicit CSV/file upload documentation, confirmation that spreadsheet-ingested data is treated like connector data (modeled, refreshed, mapped), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can load a CSV or spreadsheet as a first-class data source when no connector exists

citations.quote: Headcount planning backed by live HRIS, ATS, ERP, and spreadsheet data.
Bi-directional Excel and Google Sheets workflows, including pull/push sync
